crossRefs.note: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.
translations.bsb: The six hundred Danites stood at the entrance of the gate, armed with their weapons of war.
translations.kjv: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
translations.asv: And the six hundred men girt with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.
